blocks.text: Queues buffer data streams. When you watch a video online, it arrives in small chunks: a buffering queue stores and loads parts of the video ahead of what you are watching, so it plays smoothly even when internet data is delayed. A printer queue similarly holds several documents and processes them one at a time in the order received.

blocks.prompt: What happens to a streaming video if the buffer queue runs empty?
blocks.explanation: Playback pauses (the video 'buffers') until more chunks arrive and are enqueued.

items: Buffering: a queue holds data chunks ahead of use so streaming stays smooth.
